arguments.command:
cd /home/runner/work/pi-action/pi-action; git add src/defaults.ts src/defaults.test.ts src/inputs.ts src/inputs.test.ts src/test-helpers.ts action.yml README.md && git commit -q -m "feat: add the worktree_snapshots and worktree_snapshot_* inputs

worktree_snapshots (default true) turns working-tree continuity on or off.
worktree_snapshot_max_file_mb (10) and worktree_snapshot_max_total_mb (100)
limit the untracked files a snapshot keeps; worktree_snapshot_exclude
(default empty) lists globs of untracked files never to keep. Ignored files
are never kept. Both action steps get the inputs.

Refs #33" && git add -A src && git commit -q -m "feat: restore the working tree in each run, and save it in the always() step

run.ts gives the thread the worktree settings (off by input and on pull
requests from forks), ends the run when pi-action asked whether to rewind
the files (or the answer was Cancel), and treats an answer to that question
as pi-action's own: the comments still waiting are submitted, not the answer.

push.ts opens the thread without resuming its work, saves the working tree
when it differs from the snapshot the thread points at, and pushes both refs
atomically.

Also: capture works in a repository with no tracked files, the snapshot of
a first wrapper is its only parent, and the payload field helper is shared.

Refs #33" && git push -q 2>&1 | tail -1; git log --oneline | head -6
